score.executive_summary:
Gravipack has a genuinely distinctive product (a patented-claimed "exosquelette" strap system), real recognition (Concours Lépine silver 2018, INPI Trophées 2022 finalist, RATP deployment) and broad retail distribution. Search engines, however, see a fragmented, over-optimised and weakly trusted brand. The provisional **SEO Health Score is 33/100** (75 % of claude-seo's weight measurable without crawling the site) and the **off-site visibility score is 35/100**.

**1. The audited domain is not the live site.** `gravipack.fr` has zero indexed pages; the store lives on `gravipack.com`, but search engines index it on two hosts (apex and `www`), plus a legacy PrestaShop store (`presta.gravipack.com`) and other brand storefronts. Duplicate product URLs, cart/sort/filter parameters and thin archives dilute crawl budget and ranking signals. Consolidating to one canonical host with 301 redirects is the first, cheapest win.

**2. Titles and categories fight each other.** About 76 % of sampled titles exceed 60 characters and over half repeat "anti mal de dos", so the home page, categories and ~30 products cannibalise one keyword while the market's real head terms ("sac à dos ergonomique", "cartable ergonomique", "sac à dos ordinateur ergonomique") go unclaimed.

**3. Health claims are the biggest trust and ranking risk.** "-92 %", "anti-douleur", "dispositif médical" and "remboursé par la Sécurité sociale" have no public primary evidence (no published study, no CE/EUDAMED or LPP record found; the reimbursement source actually describes employer funding). For a YMYL-adjacent product, Google's quality systems and Merchant Center reward substantiated, carefully worded claims.

**4. Gravipack doesn't own its own name.** For "gravipack" the home page ranked only #6-#9 in the results we sampled; "gravipack avis/arnaque" is led by Trustpilot (3.1/5, 9 reviews, negatives unanswered), a critical Outzer test and sceptical forums; marketplaces outrank the store for 4 of 5 model names, with no price parity.

**5. Little content for discovery.** There are almost no guides, comparison pages, size guides or a B2B/TMS-prevention hub, no Wikidata entity, and no independent press since February 2024, so AI answer engines and "meilleur…" comparatifs don't cite Gravipack.

Fix order: consolidate hosts and clean the index (week 1), rewrite claims, titles and categories and answer every review (weeks 2-3), then build evidence, guides, comparison and B2B content plus digital PR (month 2). The on-site half of the audit (schema, Core Web Vitals, images, robots/sitemaps) is ready to run as soon as the domains are allowed in the audit environment.

clusters.title: gravipack.fr, the audited domain, has no indexed pages, and the store's indexed URLs are split between gravipack.com and www.gravipack.com
clusters.merge_notes: Open with context for the user: the audited URL gravipack.fr is not where the indexed store lives, and every third-party link or mention observed names gravipack.com. Zero pages for site:gravipack.fr is exactly what a correct 301 to .com produces. The .fr part is therefore Low unless the on-site check shows .fr parked, lapsed, not resolving or serving duplicate 200 pages. In those cases it becomes Medium, and higher if .fr is printed on packaging or in press. Host split: the counts describe URLs seen across about 60 queries (58 www, 40 apex, 16 presta = 114), not the size of the index. No product or category path was recorded on both hosts, only the home page. Drop 87's 'product and category URLs exist on both hosts' and describe it as mixed-host indexing, which may be stale entries in a US-located, non-Google index. Several 'host duplicates' are really slug duplicates (Light Promax, G-Pack); those go to the dup-products cluster. WordPress redirect_canonical() and Yoast/Rank Math normally enforce one host, so if both return 200, check the cache, CDN or vhost before adding .htaccess/Nginx rules (loop risk). Fix-quality step 0: find which host is canonical today (WP home/siteurl, plugin canonical, sitemap host, GSC-selected canonical) and keep it. www may be the current canonical (about 25 products, /faq/ and many posts are on www). Take a full backup and use a maintenance window before any siteurl change. Use a GSC Domain property. From 34, drop the misleading 'only gravipack.com/ and /nos-engagements/ surfaced in 45 searches' (site: queries found about 98 URLs); the missing .fr link profile also weakens the 'wasted equity' argument. From 64, drop counting gravipack.fr as one of '4 hosts'; presta goes to the presta cluster. onsite_check: curl -sI for http/https on gravipack.fr, www.gravipack.fr, gravipack.com and www.gravipack.com should give a single 301 hop to the canonical host. Also check the rel=canonical host and the sitemap host.

clusters.title: The legacy PrestaShop store presta.gravipack.com still appears in search results with old product, study and award pages
clusters.merge_notes: These are two duplicate phase-1 findings; merge them. 16 URLs were observed: /2-accueil, /22-produit, /73-gravipack, /72-sac-a-dos-scolaire, /24-sac-a-dos-sport, /40-etude-scientifique-soulage-le-dos-gravipack, /59-concours-lepine-medaille-argent-..., /plan-du-site-gravipack, /content/1-livraison… and product pages for Safar Vibe, Business Talk, Hiking33, Road Adventure, Sherpa 45 and Feather. In one run of the results we sampled, presta ranked #9 for 'gravipack hiking 33'. Live status (200/301/404) is unknown and indexes lag, so keep Medium; raise to High only if curl shows presta still serves 200 pages. Soften 'outdated prices': 249 € was still the regular Sherpa price in 2026 (the Decathlon promo at 149,90 € ran 18/06-30/08/2026 and has ended). Prices, the '2-3 mois' reservation wording and the delivery terms came from unsaved summaries, so do not assert them. Fix-quality: no catch-all RewriteRule to the home page (Google treats it as a soft 404). Map URL by URL to existing live equivalents, not to not-yet-created URLs such as /cartable-ergonomique/; send unmapped URLs to the closest category or return 410. Keep the presta host serving the 301s (do not remove DNS or the vhost). Move the study and Lépine content to the evidence and awards pages before 301-ing them (not 410). This cluster owns the presta redirect plan; the storefronts and model-serp clusters only reference it.

clusters.title: Other brand storefronts and hosts (gravipack.ma, gravipacker.com, a probable agency staging host) show different catalogues, model names and prices
clusters.merge_notes: 130 is confirmed. gravipack.ma prices in EUR (Rome 119.90, Dublin 249.90, Trek Air 25L 129, Sherpa Peak 50L 189), promises 'livraison rapide partout dans le monde' (overlapping the French market), uses different model names and shows a 1-year warranty on its bureautique page. gravipacker.com is another storefront. The presta part belongs to the presta cluster; do not repeat its redirect plan here. 120: gravipack.archemia.fr appeared only in a ScamAdviser result (#9 for 'gravipack arnaque' in one run). Archemia is a web agency in Nanterre, so this is probably a dev/staging host. No page from that host was found indexed, so the duplicate-content risk is speculative (Low sub-item). Fix: HTTP auth, or X-Robots-Tag noindex on staging. 17 (Info): 'no regional version, hreflang not applicable' is partly contradicted by gravipack.ma. hreflang (fr-FR / fr-MA plus x-default) applies only if .ma is meant as a regional version of the same catalogue; otherwise differentiate or consolidate it. onsite_check: who operates gravipack.ma and gravipacker.com; curl -sI gravipack.archemia.fr; site: checks in GSC and Bing.

clusters.title: The same products are indexed under several URLs, including a second /produit-gravipack/ base and duplicated slugs and titles
clusters.merge_notes: Observed groups: Light Promax x3; Sherpa Kaki x3 (including /produit-gravipack/sac-a-dos-sherpa-kaki and /produit-gravipack/sac-a-dos-sherpa); Business Talk V4 x3; Hiking Terracotta x2 (/produit/ vs /produit-gravipack/sac-a-dos-revolutionnaire); Cargo Max x2 with identical titles. Corrections: the two G-Pack URLs (collège/lycée vs professionnels/vélo) may be two real products sharing a title. The two Pearl URLs have different titles. The '-copie' Compostelle 65 L is a different capacity, so it belongs to the slugs cluster, not here. Short /produit-gravipack/ URLs may be 301s or shortlinks still listed by a stale, non-Google index. 23 was rated High with an 'unverifiable' verdict, which breaks the evidence rule, so use Medium and verify on-site. 86: one URL per colour (Sherpa bleu/orange/kaki, Hiking gris/terracotta, Oslo rouge, Pearl gris) is a pattern Google supports with ProductGroup markup (hasVariant, variesBy, productGroupID), so it is not the defect in itself. Give both options: keep variant URLs and add ProductGroup markup, or merge into a WooCommerce variable product with 301s. Real cannibalisation needs GSC (query → pages). onsite_check: curl -sI each URL; view-source rel=canonical; GSC URL Inspection; the WooCommerce permalink base and any plugin or old base generating /produit-gravipack/.

clusters.title: Cart, sort and filter parameter URLs appear in the index (?add-to-cart=, ?order=, filter_product_cat=)
clusters.merge_notes: 4 parameter URLs out of about 114 observed. Their titles use old suffixes, which points to old crawl snapshots. Medium per the verifier; downgrade to Low if the live site already noindexes or blocks them. The 'gravipack prix' sample showed a www boutique ?order=price duplicate at #5. Drop the claim that bot add-to-cart hits distort stock: WooCommerce does not reserve stock on add-to-cart, so only analytics and session pollution are real. Keep the sequencing: noindex first, and Disallow ?add-to-cart= in robots.txt only after the URLs drop out. Do not combine noindex with a canonical to another URL on filter pages. onsite_check: curl -sI 'https://<host>/?add-to-cart=6527' and the boutique ?orderby= URL, then check the X-Robots-Tag or meta robots; also review robots.txt and the Yoast/Rank Math noindex settings for filtered archives.

clusters.title: Low-value archives and duplicate CMS pages are indexed (attribute/tag archives, a /category/ base, a /test/ copy, duplicate contact pages)
clusters.merge_notes: Remove paginated /page/2/ URLs from the finding; pagination should stay indexable with a self-canonical. 'Thin' needs word and product counts we do not have, so say 'low-value'. The /category/ second base and /contacts/ carry the old suffix and may be stale entries. /test/ duplicates the SOFINS post (same title): noindex it or 301 it if it returns 200. The '-2' slug (/actualites-gravipack-2/) only shows a slug collision. The two RATP posts and /nos-engagements/ vs /a-propos-…/ can be legitimately distinct, so do not call them duplicates. 'Innovation and Militaire list the same posts' is unsupported; drop it. /devis/ vs /devis-gravipack/ belongs to the B2B cluster. About 8 URLs on a site of about 100, so Low. onsite_check: HTTP status of /test/, /contacts/, /contact/ and /category/…; Yoast/Rank Math search-appearance settings for product attributes and tags.

clusters.title: Title tags are over-long, carry a bloated site-wide suffix and stacked claim keywords, and sometimes omit the model name or contain typos
clusters.merge_notes: Per the critic, report once. Numbers: 76/98 gravipack.com titles exceed 60 characters (median 65), or 87/114 including presta. 13 URLs carry the suffix ' - Gravipack, le sac à dos exosquelette anti-mal de dos homme femme enfant', producing 182-204-character titles (Compostelle 25/35/65 L, archives, posts). Engines shorten titles rather than lengthen them, so this is almost certainly the template. 'Four different suffixes' may come from crawl snapshots of different dates, so say 'at least two templates observed'. Drop 'Google is rewriting titles': it is unsupported, and the titles come from a US-located non-Google engine. Typos were verbatim at crawl time ('Sac randonner léger … Pearl', 'militaire d'assault', 'allege', 'Sac a dos', 'allègent', lowercase 'gravipack') and may since be fixed, so treat them as 'likely'. Missing model names: Oslo Rouge, Centurion, ToolMaster, Business Talk V4 25L, Gravitech; the brand is missing on Sherpa bleu and Oslo. Austerlitz is 85 characters, Sherpa Kaki 90, home 63; the home page is not a product title. 'Archives' titles on /categorie/innovation/, /technologie/, /militaire/ and the accessories category; the mentions-légales title. 'Home has two titles' is weak (one was a parameter URL); drop it. Claim tokens: 'révolutionnaire' in about 10 titles (not about 15), plus 'apesanteur', 'meilleur', 'la seule au monde', '92%' and 'anti-TMS'. The health-claims cluster owns the therapeutic-wording rewrite; this cluster owns length, template and model-first format. Fix-quality: stage the changes, and do not strip 'anti mal de dos' from PDP titles before a hub ranks. Fix the suffix in the Yoast/Rank Math title templates. The slug bullets from 33 go to the slugs cluster. onsite_check: view-source <title> for the home page, 3 PDPs, 1 category and 1 post; the plugin title templates.

clusters.title: Product slugs are very long and keyword-stuffed, and some contain typos or '-copie' leftovers
clusters.merge_notes: Confirmed from the URLs themselves: 30/39 product URLs exceed 100 characters (median 110; the longest is 205, for City). 37 slugs repeat 'anti-mal-de-dos'. Typos: 'randonner' (Easy Travel, Helsinki), 'oganizer', 'hikking33', 'assault', and the blog slug '…autresvos-enfants…' (title edited after the slug was generated). '-copie' on Compostelle 65 L and the solar battery. Also 'pas-cher', 'certainement-le-meilleur-sac-au-monde' and 'la-seule-au-monde'. The content mismatches ('30l' vs 33 L, 'Barracuda') come from snippets and need a live check. Low: URL words are a minor signal and every change needs a 301, so no mass rename. Change slugs only when merging duplicates or fixing typos and claims, with 1:1 301s, updated internal links and sitemap, and no chains with the presta redirect map.

clusters.title: Dozens of pages target the same 'anti mal de dos' and 'exosquelette' terms, so the home page, category hub and product pages compete
clusters.merge_notes: The repetition pattern is real: 53/98 titles contain 'anti mal de/au dos', 28/39 product titles do, 37 slugs do, and 66 titles contain 'exosquelette'. Soften the harm. In the extended results we sampled, the hiking category ranked about 5th and the home page about 6th for 'sac à dos randonnée anti mal de dos', and Gravipack held 5 of the top 10 for 'sac à dos porte-outils anti mal de dos', which is domination, not proven harm. Standard and extended modes disagree. 19's overlap of 4 shared URLs comes from ubiquitous URLs (ergo-corner/55, home, arsayo; anti-pattern 5). Without ergo-corner the overlap is 2, which means 'interlink', not 'one page'. 'Losing it to a reseller' is overstated: 7 of 9 results relate to Gravipack, and ergo-corner sells Gravipack (see the reseller cluster). A hub already exists, /categorie-produit/tous-les-sacs-a-dos-exosquelette/, so the fix is re-targeting and internal linking, not a new hub. Confirm real cannibalisation in GSC (Performance → query → pages). Fix-quality: stage it. Publish and link the hub first, and keep 'anti mal de dos' as a secondary modifier in PDP titles (subject to the health-claims decision). Use CollectionPage + ItemList + BreadcrumbList markup on the hub, not Article.

clusters.title: Segment categories rank mainly for 'anti mal de dos' wordings and miss the market's generic head terms (sac à dos ergonomique, cartable ergonomique, sac randonnée léger…)
clusters.merge_notes: 135 supersedes 25. What holds: no Gravipack URL for 'sac à dos ergonomique' (E7) in the results we sampled. The outillage hub is #9 for 'sac à dos porte-outils', stable on re-run, and its title now reads 'Sac à dos exosquelette pour l'outillage professionnel Gravipack'. Corrections: the legal page is NOT the only URL with 'sac à dos ergonomique' (the Centurion, Kingston and Dublin PDPs also have it), so drop 'phrase wasted on a legal page'. 10 segment sub-categories already exist (randonnée, scolaire, business/télétravail, voyage, urbain, médical, militaire/tactique, outillage, claie de portage, nouveaux), so never say hubs are missing (93 is refuted). 'Anti mal de dos' is a feature modifier, not a brand modifier. Most absences come from standard mode, a US index and single runs (médical, ordinateur, militaire), so call them 'likely'. Extended data shows gravipack.com does rank for its core terms: scolaire #1-#3, ergonomique mal de dos #2/#4, E1 #4-#6, randonnée #5-#6, ordinateur #3-#5. 24: the 'cartable ergonomique' results are led by primary-school cartables (ergobag, univers-cartable), while Gravipack's school category targets collège/lycée/étudiant. That is an adjacent segment, so add 'cartable' vocabulary only where accurate. The Feather Plus price is unverified; drop it. School-URL cannibalisation goes to the cannibalisation cluster. Fix-quality: do not rename the parent slug 'tous-les-sacs-a-dos-exosquelette'. It would change about 12 child URLs and the URL ranking for 'sac à dos exosquelette'. Prefer a new 'Sacs à dos ergonomiques' category or landing page, or a title and H1 that carry both terms. The Rank Math option is 'Remove product category base'.

clusters.title: Few guide pages target informational carrying and back-pain queries, and Gravipack is absent from those results
clusters.merge_notes: Correction: 'the blog is press/PR only' is inaccurate. /comment-regler-les-bretelles-exosquelette-de-mon-gravipack/, /evolution-du-portage-de-sac-a-dos-jusqu-a-la-revolution-gravipack/ and /le-droit-de-la-propriete-industrielle-explique-avec-lexemple-gravipack/ exist. What holds: the 12 saved informational SERPs (K13-K24) and 13 health prompts contain 0 gravipack.com URLs in the results we sampled. Drop the unsaved result list quoted for 'comment bien porter son sac à dos' (thenorthface, sacprincesse…). Many results are Quebec, Belgian or Swiss sources (US-located index), so treat them as directional. Drop 'AI answers summarise Gravipack as unverified'; that was the audit tool's own summariser. Some SERPs are mixed-intent ('sac à dos randonnée anti mal de dos'). Fix-quality: stay out of hard-YMYL condition queries (scoliose, hernie discale), where a retailer cannot credibly rank. Focus on carrying, weight and fit guides (poids du cartable, régler son sac, porter une charge lourde), reviewed by a named health professional, with no therapeutic claims.

clusters.title: No comparison or alternatives content answers 'Gravipack vs …' and comparison intent
clusters.merge_notes: 125 supersedes 94. Change '30-45 % of commercial SERPs' to about 20-35 % (K1 2/9; K4 and K6 3/9). Drop 'HIGH mismatch'; the page-type taxonomy rates it MEDIUM. Say 'none found in 2 searches', not 'exists anywhere'. Evaluation intent is real (the i-trekkings test and Gomet rank). A brand-authored 'best of' that includes its own product rarely ranks for 'meilleur…'. Prefer honest pages: Gravipack vs Osprey Aura AG Anti-Gravity (relevant to 'sac à dos anti gravité'), exosquelette vs sac à dos classique, Gravipack vs ceinture ventrale/porte-charge. Use a fair methodology and disclosure, make no medical claims, and set no fixed 1,500-word floor (size each page to the intent). Scope markup with ItemList/Article/Product.

clusters.title: There is no single, consistent explainer for 'sac à dos exosquelette', and the brand describes its product several different ways
clusters.merge_notes: Soften the framing. In the 'sac à dos exosquelette' results we sampled, Gravipack holds 2 of 9 (catalogue #6, home #7), and 5 more results are about Gravipack (ergo-corner, i-trekkings, compostelle-autrement, Decathlon Hiking 33, Google Patents). Only kentfaith and alloprod are generic, so 'defined by third parties' is overstated. The gap is a citable definition page. Wording: 'the category term it is most associated with', not 'the concept it created', because load-transferring pack exoskeletons predate it. Explainer-like posts already exist (/evolution-du-portage…/, /et-si-votre-sac-a-dos-ne-pesait-presque-plus-rien/, /inventeur-dun-sac-a-dos-en-apesanteur/). Consolidate them into one page with 301s rather than starting from zero. The definition must state that the bag's weight does not change and that the load is transferred to the hips. 76: the descriptors vary ('exosquelette', 'en apesanteur', 'EVA mémoire de forme'). Correction: the Compostelle titles DO contain 'exosquelette', via the site-wide suffix, which implies an exoskeleton on EVA products that may not have one; fix the suffix in the titles cluster. Off-entity products (solar battery, paracord bracelet, dragonne, porte-clé) blur the entity only mildly; keep them out of the core categories. Drop the trademark overstatement about 'apesanteur'.

clusters.title: No public size/fit table maps height and weight to strap settings, although bags are adjusted to each buyer
clusters.merge_notes: Partly refuted. Product pages (Business Talk V4, Hiking, Tokyo) say each bag is personalised free of charge to the buyer's height and weight (±10 cm, ±8 kg). Austerlitz asks for height and weight at order. An adjustment guide exists (/comment-regler-les-bretelles-exosquelette-de-mon-gravipack/), so drop 'no sizing page surfaced'. Remaining gap: no public table and no 'comment se mesurer' content. Osprey and Arsayo own size-guide results, and Ergo-Corner shows M/L/XL sizes.

clusters.title: B2B and occupational (TMS/QVT) demand has no indexable hub; the offers sit inside product pages and service 'products'
clusters.merge_notes: 133 supersedes 11 (and the refuted 93); 134 supersedes 32. Confirmed: 3 site-restricted searches found no /entreprises/, CSE, collectivités or B2B hub. The B2B copy lives inside product pages: 'plus de 120 clients B2B et B2G', QVT/TMS, prescription by the médecin du travail, AGEFIPH/FIPHFP/MDPH/Escavie funding, and 'tarifs dégressifs' on Austerlitz. /produit/fabrication-professionnelle-gravipack/ and a payment-link product are indexed as products. Drop the buckle from the utility list; it is a real spare part. B2B content exists as news (RATP agents, VivaTech, SOFINS), so the gap is structure, not zero content (correction to 32). The /devis/ vs /devis-gravipack/ duplication is inferred from titles only. 134: the query 'Gravipack prévention TMS médecine du travail' contained the brand name, so its result is a tool artefact. Generic TMS results are 100 % institutional (INRS, DREETS, CRAMIF, OSHA, OPPBTP), so a vendor guide is an opportunity, not a defect. 141: the MOQ conflict is confirmed (20 vs 30 units on the key-ring sheets). The 20-100 L vs 20-60 L capacity may describe different product families (the Barracuda claie), so verify it. The AGEFIPH/FIPHFP wording is imprecise, not fabricated: 'reword and source precisely'. Do not cite seo-local's Whitespark local-pack factor for national B2B intent. Demand is unquantified, so Medium.

clusters.title: RATP's own pages document its use of Gravipack, but this has not been turned into a case study or links
clusters.merge_notes: The evidence is stronger than the finding says. At least six RATP-owned URLs name Gravipack: the CSR pages (FR/EN); the VivaTech 2023 newsroom and event pages (about 50 roaming maintenance workers already equipped, with a plan to equip track teams); the 'Cahiers d'expertise' innovation PDFs (FR/GB); an Askip' internal report; and the 2024 ASDR page. The ICI article 'La RATP innove avec les exosquelettes' dates from about early 2024 (RATP press release of 29/02/2024). The VivaTech year behind the owned post is 2023. Treat these as several link-reclamation targets plus one dated case-study page (with RATP's approval) linked from the B2B hub. Do not present it as an endorsement beyond what RATP states.

clusters.title: Therapeutic, medical-device and reimbursement wording ('anti-douleur', 'anti-TMS', 'dispositif médical', 'remboursé par la Sécurité sociale') and absolute superlatives are used without substantiation
clusters.merge_notes: 101 supersedes 48, 68, 89 and 78; 99 supersedes 49; 98 supersedes 51. Report once, per the critic. Owned evidence (SERP titles; pages could not be fetched): 'anti-douleur' on Sherpa Kaki (3 URLs) and Light Promax (2 URLs, slug 'porte-outil-anti-douleur'); 'anti-TMS' on the randonnée and claie categories; 'allège le poids de 92%' in the school category title; superlatives on presta and in slugs. Partner titles add Decathlon Feather 'Allège la charge de 92%'. Corrections: 'sauvez des vies' on the medic bag describes the users' work and is not a therapeutic claim, so do not cite it (the /sac-a-dos-medical/ category is a bag for medics). Superlatives ('le seul au monde', 'meilleur sac au monde') fall under misleading-advertising rules (L121-1/L121-2 C. conso), not MDR intended purpose. The 'dispositif médical (préventif)' wording comes from press (JDG 2021, Maddyness 2024) AND company representatives (the founder in fnh.ma; a licensee co-director on francebleu). No owned page using it was found by site: search. No CE/EUDAMED/ANSM record surfaced, but EUDAMED is not web-indexed, so that is weak evidence. Under MDR Art. 2(1), intended purpose is judged from labelling and advertising: either follow the conformity route or switch to consumer-product wording. Reimbursement: the only surface is one undated founder interview on challenge.ma (a Moroccan outlet, about 2022-23). Its own text describes employer funding ('pris en charge par l'employeur'; the médecin du travail may prescribe), so the claim is contradicted, and it was not found on gravipack.com. The Merchant Center risk is speculative, and the Cass. soc. 2017 reading needs checking by counsel. L4122-2 and L4624-3 C. travail are cited correctly. 60: the children's line raises the YMYL bar (school category title, G-Pack, Kingston 'Vive la rentrée scolaire', Feather), so get a paediatric or physiotherapy reviewer. 62: the relevant Merchant Center policy is Misrepresentation, not 'Healthcare and medicines'; account status is unknown, so the risk is hypothetical. The Content API sunset goes to the schema-mc cluster. FAQ copy about reimbursement only if it is real and documented; FAQPage markup gives no rich result. Fix: remove 'anti-douleur' and 'anti-TMS' from titles, slugs and partner feeds, decide with counsel whether 'anti mal de dos' can stay as a descriptive modifier, and give French rewrite examples. Severity Medium: the p2 verifier says High overstates a title rewrite and the evidence is SERP titles only. The study-evidence cluster is the High item.

clusters.title: The '-92 %' claim rests on a 2019 Lyon study with no public primary document and no citable evidence page on the main site, while forum doubts about it rank

The only study page found is presta.gravipack.com/40-etude-scientifique-soulage-le-dos-gravipack ('L'étude scientifique du sac à dos en apesanteur Gravipack.'). Migrate its content to a new evidence page on the canonical host and 301 it there. Change 'no citable evidence page' to 'none on the main domain'. The 92 % is stated as weight, load and pressure interchangeably: FAQ 'évacue jusqu'à 92 % de la charge'; school category 'allège le poids de 92%'; post /inventeur-dun-sac-a-dos-en-apesanteur/; Decathlon 'Allège la charge de 92%'. For 'gravipack étude Lyon', the results we sampled were randonner-leger x6, moodle univ-lyon1, Maddyness and Europe 1. 112, reported neutrally: randonner-leger threads contain unverified third-party statements that the work was a preliminary pre-study by a master's intern and that the lab would not share it without a formal request. The stronger 'asked not to use it for promotion' wording appeared only in an earlier summary, so label it an unverified allegation. The SEO issue is that these threads rank on brand searches unanswered, not whether they are true. The YouTube channel still calls it a 'scientific and medical study'. Note the same-name lab ambiguity (an LBMC at ENS Lyon works in cell biology; the biomechanics LBMC is Univ. Gustave Eiffel/Lyon 1). 52: no named independent health professional is visible (absence only; the 'prescrit par les médecins du travail' premise came from the brief, not the results). Adjacent signals exist (RATP deployment, a possible Lyon 1 link). Reword 'every summary labelled it unverified' (that was the audit tool's summariser) to 'third-party sources frequently question it'. Fix: one evidence page giving the protocol, sample, authors, date, the exact measured quantity and its limits (with the lab's permission), or else scope or drop the figure; footnote every 92 % mention; name a reviewer. High: it is the brand's headline promise on owned pages, in a YMYL-adjacent topic, with doubts ranking on brand queries.

clusters.title: Review and 'arnaque' searches surface critical content the brand has not answered (Trustpilot 3.1/5 with unanswered 2026 complaints, the Outzer review, sceptical forum threads)

Outzer 'Un sac a dos terrifiant' (Sherpa 45, about €240; the reviewer estimates about 30 L and did not measure it). randonner-leger threads (which also rank on generic 'soulager épaules' queries) and forum.bushwalk.com. Change 'mostly sceptical' to 'mixed, with sceptical forum threads prominent', since positive Trustpilot and Fnac reviews exist. Owned pages that answer these queries exist but do not rank (/gravipackers/, the Lépine post). 'Summaries show AI engines echo it' is a hypothesis to test, not evidence. seo-local has no TrustScore 4.0 threshold, so drop that rationale. 108 (Info context): no DGCCRF, ARPP or scam-report record about Gravipack surfaced, and the signal-arnaques #947856 hit cannot be tied to Gravipack. Use it as reassurance, not as a finding. The study allegation lives in the study cluster. High because Trustpilot ranks first for the 'avis' and 'arnaque' modifiers with unanswered 2026 refund complaints.

clusters.title: On-site social-proof figures ('4,7 sur Google' from 1,121-1,175 reviews, '500 000 clients satisfaits') are not independently verified

clusters.title: Company facts are stale or conflicting across the contact page and third-party profiles (legal name, seat, headcount, awards)

EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS, SIREN 840 543 383: GRAVIBAG (2018, Sens), then GRAVIPACK (07/2022), then EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT (2025) are successive names of one company. Seat: Sens (2018), then Vincennes (end of 2022), then 10 rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris since 19/05/2026 (siège SIRET 840 543 383 00045). Capital 16 960 €. clusters.title: The likely Google Business Profile and local citations still show the old Vincennes address, while the registered seat is now in Paris
clusters.merge_notes: 95 is superseded by 102, 121 and 139; its entity part is handled in the entity cluster. Facts: the seat has been 10 rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris since 19/05/2026. clusters.title: The YouTube channel is named 'zero gravity backpack' and uses medical wording; the social and community footprint is small or stale
clusters.merge_notes: 115 supersedes 70 and 46. Critic contradiction resolved: the official channel exists (@Gravipack and /c/Gravipack, #2-#4 for 'gravipack' in the results we sampled) and already has per-model videos (Tokyo, Rome, Light Promax, MedMax, RATPLovesStartUp); the newest is from about mid-June 2025. Drop 70's 'no YouTube presence' and 46's missing-video list. The '766' figure is unlabelled, so do not call the channel small. Remaining issues: the channel name 'zero gravity backpack' and medical wording in its description (the claim part goes to the study and health clusters). 116: Instagram's ~23K is a snapshot from about March 2023 (196 posts), and a lookalike @granipack (26K) exists. Facebook has about 2.4K and LinkedIn about 1.9K, and the latest indexed LinkedIn posts date from Sept/Oct 2023 (indexing is partial). No TikTok or Pinterest was found, but these are poorly indexed, so absence does not prove no presence. Follower counts are not a ranking factor. 117: no Reddit discussion found; that is absence only, and normal for a French niche brand whose community is on randonner-leger. The YouTube 0.737 figure from seo-geo is a correlation. Video rich results appear mainly when the video is the page's main content. Fix: rename the channel 'Gravipack', remove the medical wording, cross-link videos and PDPs, and keep uploads dated and regular.

clusters.title: AI and search crawler access, server rendering, Bing coverage and llms.txt need an on-site check
clusters.merge_notes: Both are unverifiable (robots.txt, WAF and rendered HTML could not be fetched). Bot roles: the search and answer crawlers OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot and Bingbot should be allowed.
